# Radio

One choice from a small set, all visible, in a named RadioGroup; square, and told from a checkbox by its mark.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

**Square, on purpose.** What tells a person “one of these” is the grouping, the legend and the behaviour — arrows move the choice, Tab leaves the group — not the circle; and a circle would be the only curve in a system cut with a blade. So a radio differs from a checkbox by its *mark*: a checkbox fills and has a check cut out of it, a radio keeps its cloth and has a smaller solid square set inside. Semantics are unchanged: Base UI renders `role="radio"` in a named `radiogroup`.

## Usage

### When to use

- Exactly one of two to five options that people should compare side by side.
- Options that each need a description, such as what happens when a tool call fails.

### When not to

- Any number of options. Use [Checkbox](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-checkbox--overview.md).
- More options than fit comfortably, or options that do not need comparing. Use [Select](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-select--overview.md).
- Switching views, where the change is instant and nothing is submitted. Use [Segmented control](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-segmented-control--overview.md).
- A single setting that is on or off. Use [Switch](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-switch--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Give the group a label that asks the question: “When a tool call fails”.
- Don’t: Leave the group unnamed; a screen reader then announces “group” and nothing else.

### Content

- Option labels are parallel and start the same way: “Retry, then continue”, “Skip the step”, “Halt the run”.
- The consequence goes in description: “The run is marked failed and the owner is paged.”

## API

### `Radio` (component)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  |

Also accepts the props of `NativeButtonProps`, `RadioRootProps`.

### `RadioGroup` (component)

The group, named by a visible label in the rótulo register via `aria-labelledby` — a radiogroup with no name is announced as "group" and nothing else, which leaves a screen reader user choosing between options to a question they never heard.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The question the options answer. Names the radiogroup. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `vertical` |  |

Also accepts the props of `RadioGroupProps`.

Types: `RadioGroupProps`, `RadioProps`

## Accessibility

### Keyboard

| Key | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus into the group at the checked radio, and Tab again leaves the group. |
| ArrowDown or ArrowRight | Moves to and checks the next radio, wrapping at the end. |
| ArrowUp or ArrowLeft | Moves to and checks the previous radio. |
| Space | Checks the focused radio. Enter does not. |

### Mola handles

- Base UI renders `role="radio"` inside `role="radiogroup"`, so the square is still announced as a radio button.
- `RadioGroup` is named by its visible `label` through `aria-labelledby`, and described by its `description`.
- Each radio is named by its `label` alone, and its `description` arrives through `aria-describedby`.

### You handle

- Give `RadioGroup` a `label` that asks the question the options answer.
- Give every radio a `label`.
